decision: Reject this same-GroupId peer-target offset as a Top5 candidate. No implementation, beta fitting or GPU experiment is warranted.

proof.support_count: n_g = number of rows with GroupId=g in the fit training pool.
proof.proposed_branch: If n_g==0, return the exact original base probability, without any calibrated intercept or recomputation.
proof.final_inference: Every one of4277 test rows has n_g==0 even with all8693 training labels. Therefore every final probability equals the corresponding matched baseMitra probability for every alpha/beta choice.
proof.group_validation: Whole-GroupId CV similarly gives n_g==0 for every query. The candidate exactly equals its matched base in every group fold by construction.
proof.consequence: Random-row CV may show a benefit from labelled relatives, but that evidence is unavailable for every actual test passenger. This is a deployment-coverage failure, not proof that within-group labels lack correlation.

contract_and_leakage.historical_contract: Frozen iterate/run038/context20 protocols explicitly prohibit target propagation within those experiments. A newly authorized, separately frozen protocol could study lawful training-label encoding; it must not silently alter old no-target claims. We do not treat every supervised encoding as inherently forbidden.
contract_and_leakage.hypothetical_honest_nesting: For each outer fold, fit baseMitra on each inner training pool, derive peer counts only from that same inner pool, and use inner-held-out targets solely to learn beta. Exclude each query target/self from counts. Fit the final base on fulloutertrain and construct peer mapping from fulloutertrain labels only; outerquery labels remain scoring-only.
contract_and_leakage.remaining_distribution_shift: Inner2/3 support, outerfullsupport and randomfold family overlap imply different count/reliability distributions. Actualtest and GroupCV collapse to nopeer evidence. A fixed shrinkagealpha/L2 cannot create missing deployment information.
contract_and_leakage.beta_review_not_needed: No existing OOF labels were inspected to select alpha/beta, no formula/penalty search was conducted, and no query target relationship was analyzed.

gate_limit: The existing A policy permits GroupCV equality. Thus positive randomfold gains plus a forced group tie could satisfy that numeric check while final predictions are unchanged. This candidate-specific impossibility is sufficient to reject before expensive eligibility validation; no historical gate or policy file is modified.
cost_avoided: The proposed nested scheme requires3 inner basefits plus1 fullouter basefit per outerfold:12 fits for a3fold screen versus3 for a plain base. That cost cannot buy any different final prediction under the declared exactfallback.

independent_review.method: Independently reread only PassengerId, reproducing6217/3063 uniquegroups and0 intersection/0 eligible testrows.
independent_review.conclusion: Agrees with decisive rejection. Fold-safe peer evidence is possible in principle; zero deployment coverage makes this particular proposal unproductive. Do not expand toSurname/Cabin/pseudo-label relations as an unannounced rescue.

recommended_next_action: Archive this hypothesis without training. Same-GroupId peer-target offset is not the next executable candidate. Any different relation or pseudo-label mechanism would be a separate proposal, outside this review.
